the crystallographic orientations of the interfaces have a strong influence on the adhesion properties of the interfaces.

the crystallographic dependence of the adhesions at the SiC/Cr and SiC/Ti interfaces.

the crystallographic effects on the adhesion of the SiC/transition metal interfaces, which is helpful for the design of high performance SiC-based composites.

the adhesion at SiC/Ti interfaces is stronger than that of SiC/Cr interface.

the SiC(1 1 ¯ 0) orientation is more favorable for the SiC/Cr interface, and the SiC(0 0 0 1) orientation is more desirable for the SiC/T interface.
